title: Propagandist of the Hegemony
entry: The colonel pinned {name}'s posters to the dugout wall and read his words out at the dawn watch. From today he is the Propagandist of the Hegemony. He still keeps his rifle.
newsText: {name} (@{handle}) draws posters and rallies his comrades under every order. The colonel named him Propagandist of the Hegemony. "Iron endures," his latest poster says. The men believe it.

newsHead: A second hospital for each side
newsText: Orders came down for both armies: dig a second hospital dugout behind the reserve line. Four more beds on each side, and room for more stretchers. The surgeons will be busy.
